46 // One row of the ISO 4217 table.
47 struct iso4217_row {
48 std::string_view code; // the alphabetic code, three capitals
49 std::string_view name; // the currency's name as SIX publishes it
50 std::uint16_t numeric; // the numeric code
51 std::int8_t scale; // the minor units, or -1 where ISO gives none (N.A., and historic codes)
52 std::string_view withdrawn; // the withdrawal date as SIX gives it ("2025-03", "1989 to 1990"), empty if current
53 std::span<const std::string_view> countries; // alpha-2 of the countries using it (SIX list one), sorted
54 std::string_view symbol; // CLDR's root-locale symbol ("A$", "€"), or the code where CLDR gives none
55 std::int8_t cash_scale; // CLDR's cash digits, or -1 where CLDR gives no cash rule
56 std::uint8_t cash_rounding; // the cash increment in units of 10^-cash_scale (5 for CHF), 0 if none
57 };

378 // One type per code. A type with scale() models snicholls::currency_like (and asset_like); the N.A. codes
379 // (XAU, XAG, XPT, XPD, XDR, the funds) and historic ones have none: give one with snicholls::with_scale.
380 // Each declares its presentation, found by ADL: a label, CLDR's root-locale symbol, and minor_units.

394 static constexpr std::string_view withdrawn() noexcept { return "2003-07"; }
397 friend constexpr auto attributes(const ADP&) noexcept { return ::snicholls::attrs(::snicholls::label{"ADP"}); }
398 };
